dispatch_mode.description: AFK/HITL classification: whether this task can be dispatched and driven to completion without a human in the loop (`afk`), or a human decision is load-bearing during execution (`hitl`). This is the field checklist item ISS-05 (docs/agents/checklists.md) is judged from. It is distinct from the runtime registry's `execution_mode` (scripts/shiki_runtime_registry.py), which names HOW a runtime executes (local_cli/github_action/...), not whether a human gates it. Optional (absent from `required`) on purpose: every task file registered before this field existed lacks it, and promoting it would invalidate all of them at once — schema `required` and scripts/validate_shiki.TASK_REQUIRED must be promoted together (tests/test_cca_verdict_consistency.TaskSchemaRequiredConsistency). Because it is optional, ISS-05 also carries a total fallback: a record without this field is classified from `assigned_runtime` (`human` => hitl, any other runtime => afk) per SADR-0008, which is `shiki_tasks.dispatch_mode_for_runtime`. Registration writes that derived value; declare the field explicitly to override it — an automated runtime may still be `hitl` when a human decision gates the slice.

cca_checklist_profile.description: CCA checklist ids the PR's structured verdict must judge to a terminal status (see scripts/mergegate_check.checklist_profile_coverage_failures). MergeGate blocks a verdict that omits or leaves unresolved any id declared here. Optional (absent from `required`) until every pre-existing task file carries it: promoting it to a required field would force backfilling all such files, which are outside this task's declared locks. This mirrors scripts/validate_shiki.py keeping it out of TASK_REQUIRED; the two surfaces must be promoted together (see tests/test_cca_verdict_consistency.TaskSchemaRequiredConsistency).

test_command.description: Structured command the goal loop exec's in the task worktree for the loop-observed TDD gate (ADR 0011) before opening the PR. Defaults to 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests'. acceptance_checks is free-form prose and is never exec'd.
